passing_score_scale: Pass/fail; passing threshold not publicly disclosed
exam_format: Linear (computer-based, online proctored via Pearson VUE OnVUE or at authorized test centers). ACE adds Scenario-Based questions.

testing_centers.notes: Pearson VUE test centers globally and online proctoring via Pearson VUE OnVUE. Also delivered via Alibaba Cloud Certification test centers in China and online proctoring globally.

id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. Passport required for international candidates.
exam_rules: Closed-book; no aids; no personal devices permitted during exam. ACE includes a 4-hour hands-on scenario exam in addition to the MCQ portion. Online proctored globally via Pearson VUE OnVUE.
renewal_options: Certifications are valid for 3 years. Renewal is exam-based only: pass the current version of the same exam or a higher-level exam. No continuing education (CE) credits accepted — exam-based renewal only.

retake_policy.notes: 14-day waiting period between failed attempts. No stated maximum number of attempts. Full exam fee required for each attempt.

official_study_resources.notes: Free learning paths and exam preparation materials available on Alibaba Cloud Academy.

editorial.meta_description: The ACA Big Data Associate exam is retired as of 2025-03-31. There is no successor exam available for this specific Alibaba Cloud certification program.
editorial.overview: The ACA Big Data Associate exam, certified by Alibaba Cloud, covered big data concepts, MaxCompute, DataWorks, real-time computing, and data visualization. This exam is retired as of 2025-03-31. No successor exam exists for this certification. Candidates seeking current cloud data certifications should contact Alibaba Cloud directly to identify available alternatives that align with their professional development goals and current cloud technology requirements. This credential was designed to validate skills in managing large-scale data environments within the Alibaba Cloud ecosystem, ensuring professionals could effectively utilize platform-specific tools for complex analytical tasks and data-driven decision-making processes.
editorial.who_should_take: This retired exam was intended for individuals seeking to demonstrate knowledge of big data processing on Alibaba Cloud. It was suitable for those with experience in data management, cloud computing, and analytics who wanted to validate their technical proficiency in these specific platform services.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Since this exam is retired and has no successor, do not prepare for it. Focus your efforts on current cloud data technologies. Review official Alibaba Cloud documentation to understand the latest services. Any knowledge of data architecture and cloud-based processing remains useful, but you should prioritize learning current platform features directly from the provider rather than studying for this discontinued credential. Please consult the official Alibaba Cloud website for the most relevant and up-to-date certification paths currently offered to cloud professionals.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covered the concepts of big data, including the characteristics of large data sets and the architectural principles of distributed systems used for processing information efficiently in the cloud environment.

This domain focused on MaxCompute, a platform for large-scale data processing. It covered the management of data storage and the execution of complex analytical queries within the cloud environment for enterprise users.

This domain addressed DataWorks, which provides tools for data integration, development, and management. It covered the creation of workflows and the orchestration of data tasks within the platform for various business needs.

This domain covered real-time computing capabilities, focusing on the processing of streaming data and the low-latency requirements of modern analytical applications on the cloud to ensure timely and accurate data insights.

This domain focused on data visualization, covering the methods and tools used to represent processed data sets graphically to support decision-making and analytical reporting for stakeholders across various organizational levels and departments.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The ACA Big Data Associate exam cannot be scheduled as it is retired. If you are pursuing other active Alibaba Cloud certifications, ensure you have your identification ready for your online proctored session or visit your authorized test center as instructed by the registration portal.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consisted of 60 questions in total. These were presented in a linear format using multiple choice and multiple response question types to test candidate knowledge.
The exam utilized a pass/fail grading system. The specific passing threshold was not publicly disclosed by the certifying body, meaning candidates were evaluated based on overall performance.
The exam was a 120-minute session. This duration applied to the computer-based, online proctored format or when taken at authorized test centers for all registered exam candidates.

faq.question_title: What was the cost of the exam?
faq.answer_text: The price for the exam was 200 dollars. This fee was required for registration through the official Alibaba Cloud certification portal before the exam was officially retired from service.

methodology.summary: This index was compiled by reviewing official Alibaba Cloud certification documentation and exam guides to verify the status and content of the retired ACA-BigData exam for all users.
